verdict: Zero leads for 11 days — tracking is broken, not demand.
narrative: You received 9 leads over the last 28 days, but none have been recorded since August 1 — 11 straight days of zero conversion events despite $494 in spend during that stretch. The findings point clearly to a broken conversion tracking setup, not a drop in demand: Google search spend actually increased 79% this week while the lead counter stayed at zero, which is the signature of a funnel that stopped recording, not one that stopped working. We have paused the spend acceleration and are actively repairing the conversion tracking so results reflect what is actually happening. Once tracking is confirmed clean, you should see lead volume return to the levels recorded earlier in the 28-day window.

highlights.phrase: leads recorded in the last 11 days despite ads running the entire time
spent on your top Google campaign this period with no leads tracked in the recent window
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — organic presence held steady

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking stopped firing around August 1, making leads invisible in reporting and allowing spend to accelerate into an untracked funnel.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being audited and repaired this week; spend acceleration has been flagged for review until tracking is confirmed working.
